package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"html/template"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"

	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/apps/gallery"
	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/appkit/ui/form"
)

func specimen(theme string, reviewed bool) string {
	errorText, selected := "Choose a supported interval before reviewing this selection.", ""
	if reviewed {
		errorText, selected = "", "weekly"
	}
	group := form.RenderRadioGroup(form.RadioGroup{
		Name: "schedule", Legend: "Report interval", Value: selected, Required: true,
		Options: []form.Option{{Value: "daily", Label: "Daily"}, {Value: "paused", Label: "Paused (unavailable)", Disabled: true}, {Value: "weekly", Label: "Weekly"}},
		Help: "Choose the interval for the report. No schedule will be saved.", Error: errorText,
	})
	help := form.RenderRadioGroup(form.RadioGroup{
		Name: "channel filter <&>", Legend: "Delivery channel", Value: "email", Inline: true,
		Options: []form.Option{{Value: "email", Label: "Email"}, {Value: "inbox", Label: "Inbox"}},
		Help: "Synthetic delivery options, not a notification service.",
	})
	sections, err := form.RenderSettingsSections([]form.SettingsSection{
		{HeadingID: "interval", Title: "Interval", Description: "Resolve the field error using a native choice.", Content: template.HTML(group)},
		{HeadingID: "channel", Title: "Channel", Description: "A second group keeps its own help association.", Content: template.HTML(help)},
	})
	if err != nil { panic(err) }
	message := "Synthetic form: review choices without saving any data."
	if reviewed { message = "Native browser submitted Weekly and Email. Nothing was saved." }
	return fmt.Sprintf(`<!doctype html><html lang="en" data-theme="%s"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Radio feedback specimen</title><link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/app.css"></head><body class="bg-surface text-ink p-4"><main class="mx-auto max-w-2xl"><h1 class="text-2xl font-semibold">Report preferences</h1><p class="mt-2 text-sm text-ink-muted" id="outcome">%s</p><h2 class="mt-6 text-xl font-semibold">Review choices</h2><form method="get" action="/_fixture/review"><input type="hidden" name="theme" value="%s">%s<div class="mt-4">%s</div></form></main></body></html>`, theme, message, theme, sections, form.RenderButton(form.Button{Label: "Review selection", Type: "submit", Variant: form.ButtonPrimary}))
}

func main() {
	type response struct { Path string; Status int; Header map[string][]string; Body string }
	h := gallery.New()
	responses := []response{}
	for _, p := range []string{"/forms?theme=light", "/forms?theme=dark", "/static/app.css"} {
		w := httptest.NewRecorder(); h.ServeHTTP(w, httptest.NewRequest("GET", p, nil))
		responses = append(responses, response{p, w.Code, w.Header(), w.Body.String()})
	}
	for _, theme := range []string{"light", "dark"} {
		for _, reviewed := range []bool{false, true} {
			p := "/_fixture/error?theme=" + theme
			if reviewed { p = "/_fixture/review?theme=" + theme }
			headers := map[string][]string{"Content-Type": {"text/html; charset=utf-8"}, "Content-Security-Policy": {"default-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; form-action 'self'; base-uri 'none'"}, "Cache-Control": {"no-store"}}
			responses = append(responses, response{p, 200, headers, specimen(theme, reviewed)})
		}
	}
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(responses); err != nil { panic(err) }
}
